ux_intent: Validate that browse-card content type and borrow status are perceivable by all users, including screen-reader users, and that the card's interactive icons meet minimum tap-target and contrast requirements.
figma_make_prompt:
Build a browse card list screen for the Hoopla digital library app.

Platform: mobile (iOS and Android), 390x844 base frame.
Use a top app bar with title "Browse" and a back arrow.

Layout:
- Vertical scroll list with 16px padding left and right, 12px gap between cards.
- Each card is a rounded container (12px radius, 1px border #E5E7EB, subtle drop shadow).
- Card internal layout: horizontal row. Left: thumbnail image 80x120dp. Right: vertical stack.
  - Title text (Body Medium, 16sp, weight 600, #121212).
  - Author or content-type line (Body Small, 14sp, #6B7280).
  - Bottom row: licence-status icon (24dp icon inside a 48x48dp touch target) left-aligned, kind-icon (24dp icon inside a 48x48dp touch target) right-aligned.
- Each icon has a visible text label beneath it (Caption, 12sp, #121212) showing its meaning: "Available" / "Borrowed" for licence, "Audiobook" / "eBook" / "Video" / "Music" for kind.

States:
- Default (available): thumbnail loaded, licence icon green checkmark + label "Available", kind icon shows content type + label.
- Borrowed: licence icon blue clock + label "Borrowed". Kind icon and card layout unchanged.
- Error (thumbnail load failure): placeholder grey rectangle fills the thumbnail space with a centred broken-image icon. No layout shift.
- Empty list: full-screen centred message "No titles found" with a secondary CTA "Try a different search" (outlined button, 48dp height).

Behavior:
- Tap anywhere on the card → navigate to Title Details (show as a state transition).
- Tap licence icon → small bottom sheet: "Available to borrow" or "Already borrowed — tap to manage".

Style:
- Material 3-ish, neutral. Primary text #121212. Secondary text #6B7280. Icon tint: green #10B981 for available, blue #3B82F6 for borrowed. Background #F9FAFB. Auto layout, responsive.
- All tap targets minimum 48x48dp. Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 on card background.

First step: default state with thumbnail loaded, title, author, and both icons at correct tap-target size with their labels visible.
ui_acceptance_criteria:
Given a browse card is displayed with a valid thumbnail
When the user views the card
Then the content type and borrow status are each represented by a distinct icon with a visible text label beneath it

Given the licence-status icon is rendered
When its touch-target dimensions are measured
Then the target is at least 48x48dp and the 24dp icon is centred within it

Given the card is in the error state (thumbnail load failure)
When the card is rendered
Then a placeholder with a broken-image icon fills the thumbnail space and no other card content shifts position

Given the browse list is empty
When the screen is rendered
Then the empty-state message and secondary CTA are centred and legible
manual_validation_checklist: Measure licence-status icon and kind-icon touch targets: both ≥ 48x48dp with icons centred
Verify text contrast: title #121212 on card background and secondary text #6B7280 on card background both meet 4.5:1
Confirm icon labels (Caption 12sp) are present beneath each icon in both Available and Borrowed states
Check error-state placeholder fills exactly 80x120dp — same as a loaded thumbnail; no layout reflow
Verify the empty state centres vertically and the CTA button is outlined, 48dp height, and tappable
Confirm auto layout is applied to each card row so long titles wrap without overlapping the icons
